operating_notes.text: Blended fuel consumption per ton was $124 in FY26 against $127 in FY25.
FY26 blended fuel consumption per tonne was $124 vs $127 in FY25; blended fuel cost per kcal ₹1.59 vs ₹1.53.
Green power was 40% of total power in FY26 vs 36% in FY25, with wind generation up 19% YoY.
Cement capacity utilisation was 74% in FY26 vs 77% in FY25; Q4FY26 utilisation 83% vs 85% in Q4FY25.
A ₹1.60 Cr excise levy dispute on MRP-based bagged cement was dropped by the Original Authority by order dated 3 June 2026.
Realised ₹25.65 Cr from non-core asset sales on 4 August 2026, building on ₹1,080.82 Cr realised earlier.
Exceptional gain of ₹12.62 Cr from sale of surplus lands recognized in Q1FY27.
Power and fuel costs increased to ₹609.74 Cr in Q1FY27 from ₹500.24 Cr in Q1FY26.
Transportation and handling costs rose to ₹489.81 Cr in Q1FY27 from ₹427.49 Cr in Q1FY26.
Enhanced Jayanthipuram clinker capacity from 4.61 MTPA to 5.62 MTPA and grinding capacity from 3.65 MTPA to 4.38 MTPA via debottlenecking; total capacities reached 16.95 MTPA and 27.17 MTPA.

timeline.summary: P.R. Venketrama Raja, Managing Director & Promoter, declared no new share encumbrances for The Ramco Cements Limited under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) as of 2026-04-03.
Ramco Cements announced that a ₹66.65 Cr excise duty dispute on bagged cement was dropped by the Original Authority.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,610.32 Cr (+8.9% YoY), net profit ₹150.72 Cr (+487.6% YoY).
Ramco Cements FY26 standalone revenue rises 6% to ₹9,056 Cr; net debt down by ₹817 Cr
FY26 investor update: revenue ₹9,070 Cr (+6%), EBITDA per tonne ₹788 vs ₹690, PAT ₹692 Cr including ₹573.52 Cr asset-sale gains; net debt cut to ₹3,664 Cr.
The Ramco Cements' Hard Worker campaign won six honours including the Grey Elephant Grand Prix at the Kyoorius Creative Awards.
NCLT Chennai Bench allowed the first motion application for the amalgamation of Ramco Windfarms on 27 May 2026.
2026-06-04: Original Authority dropped a ₹1.60 Cr excise levy dispute on MRP-based bagged cement by order dated 3 June 2026; no similar disputes pending.
Realised additional ₹25.65 Cr through disposal of non-core assets, taking cumulative monetisation past ₹1,106 Cr.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,273.05 Cr (+9.6% YoY), net profit ₹31.24 Cr (-63.1% YoY).
Q1FY27 results showed 10% YoY revenue growth to ₹2,276 Cr but PAT declined 63% YoY to ₹31.86 Cr due to cost pressures
The Ramco Cements Limited’s 68th AGM on August 20, 2026, passed all resolutions, including ₹2.50 dividend declaration, with 100% shareholder approval via e-voting.
Ramco Cements completed debottlenecking at Jayanthipuram works, expanding aggregate clinker capacity to 16.95 MTPA and grinding capacity to 27.17 MTPA.
